camera.description: 同机位前后对切：左半幅五年前汽修工装沾油渍，右半幅今日董事西装笔挺，眼神不变

audio.speech: 五年前，一纸合约把我赶出这道门；五年后，我连门带楼，全买了回来。

prompt: Medium shot, fixed camera, split composition: on the left the same young woman in oil-stained mechanic overalls from years ago, on the right she stands today in a sharp tailored business suit, the same steady unwavering gaze in both halves. She is Xiaoman, a Chinese woman in her early twenties with sleek black shoulder-length hair and calm defiant dark eyes. Left half: cold blue-green fluorescent garage light, oil-stained orange canvas overalls with grease marks, concrete wall and tool board behind, faint dust in the air. Right half: warm golden chandelier banquet light, a sharp charcoal-black tailored suit with a subtle sheen, dark walnut and amber gloom behind. The two halves meet on a clean vertical seam; her gaze never changes across the seam.
